name: rech
description: Local speech recognition: dictate prompts by voice and transcribe recordings with Rech. GigaAM for Russian, the best model for each other language; audio never leaves the Mac.

language.title: Dictation language
language.description: The language you dictate in. It picks the model (GigaAM for Russian) and loads it while you speak, so the text is ready under a second after you stop. 'auto' detects it, but that needs 3 s of speech and takes seconds longer; shorter phrases go to Parakeet.

pause.title: Pause that ends a phrase, seconds
pause.description: How long you can be silent before dictation stops. Raise it if you get cut off mid-thought.

sounds.title: Start and stop sounds
sounds.description: Tink when the microphone opens, Pop when it closes.
